summary: Iter 102 backend + frontend regression of new server-rendered QR poster endpoint (/api/merchant/panel/qr/poster) and merchant QR attribution flow. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass and all Scan-QR frontend interactions (dl-png/jpg/pdf/print + hero-share modal + share-copy) hit the new poster endpoint and return 200. QR scan increments analytics and a customer booking with merchant_ref_code is attributed to the merchant.

backend_checks.GET poster with foreign link (?link=http: 200 - server rebuilds link with own merchant code

frontend_checks.dl-print: PASS - fmt=png -> 200 (print dialog attempt; headless browser may not surface print UI but no 'Print failed' toast)
frontend_checks.console errors: None (only expected RN-web warnings: useNativeDriver JS fallback, pointerEvents deprecation, expo-notifications web listener no-op)

console_warnings: Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web (RN-web expected)

critical_code_review_comments: qr_poster_service.py cleanly renders SVG->PNG/JPG/PDF via cairosvg; segno for QR path; fonts loaded via a private fontconfig. Uses asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking. Good.
Route handler at merchant_panel_routes.py:qr_poster correctly re-injects merchant_code into the link if caller passes a foreign one, protecting attribution.
Poster endpoint mime map cannot KeyError because fmt is normalised to png/jpg/pdf inside render_poster().
Content-Disposition is 'inline' — good for browser preview; download filename still respected by the front-end's a[download] anchor (posterActions.ts webDownload).
Merchant role check enforced via require_role('merchant') and mrs.assert_merchant_approved – customer correctly gets 403, unauth 401.
seed_data_creation: 1 test booking created via customer with merchant_ref_code=XZ6SV49 (attribution verification only, not settled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview base URL is https://profile-kyc-panel.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests at /app/backend/tests/test_merchant_qr_poster_iter102.py require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (see conftest.py). Frontend served by Expo Web on same host; merchant demo login path: onboard-skip -> skip-notifications-button -> demo-merchant -> tab-scanqr. All Scan-QR interactive elements (hero-link, hero-share, hero-whatsapp, poster-preview, dl-png, dl-jpg, dl-pdf, dl-print, share-modal, share-copy) verified with data-testid. Server-rendered poster pipeline replaces older view-shot pipeline and works end-to-end.
